stem.en: Asha says the cell membrane is like a sheet of thin plastic: fixed, solid and still. Which fact shows that this picture is wrong?

text.en: Its lipid tails stay in contact with the water on both sides of it.

feedback.en: Tails are repelled by water. They lie between the two layers, away from water.

text.en: It is built from one layer of proteins with no lipid in it at all.

feedback.en: It is a lipid bilayer with proteins embedded in it, so this is false.

text.en: Its molecules can move sideways, flip and rotate.
It has large open holes that allow every substance to pass through.

feedback.en: It is selectively permeable, so it allows some substances through and blocks others.

explanation.en: Plastic has fixed molecules. A membrane has lipids that can move sideways, flip and rotate, which is why the model calls it fluid.

hints.en: Which word in the name of the model describes movement?
